name: @generativereality/browser-automation
description: Daemonless, per-tab-isolated browser automation CLI for Claude Code. Drives one shared headed Chrome (persistent profile + extensions) over per-target CDP — many parallel sessions, no focus stealing, nothing long-lived to crash.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && bash scripts/check-one-port.sh && npm run build && npm test
scripts.release: echo 'Releases publish from CI, not here. Bump package.json + .claude-plugin/plugin.json, commit onto master, then: git tag vX.Y.Z && git push origin vX.Y.Z — then approve the gated job in GitHub Actions. `npm publish` from a laptop 404s (granular token). See .github/workflows/release.yml.' >&2; exit 1

author: motin
